card.title: PANZER IV-G
card.flavorText: The Panzer IV-G was a German Panzer IV (Panzerkampfwagen IV) variant that was produced between March 1942 to June 1943. The Panzer IV was a medium tank used by the Axis powers throughout WWII and 8,553 units of numerous variants were manufactured throughout the war. The IV-G variant had a crew of 5 (commander, gunner, loader, driver, radio operator/bow machine-gunner), a main armament of 7.5 cm (2.95 in) KwK 40 L/48 and secondary armament of 2 × 7.92 mm MG 34 machine guns.
